---
title: Discovering pyspark and spark-nlp
subtitle: Stylometric analysis of XIXth century literature
---

```{python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
spark: SparkSession = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()

ddr = spark.sparkContext.parallelize(range(10))

ddr = ddr.map(lambda x: x * 2)

ddr.collect()
```

Ça marche !
